name: Senna Pell
lore: Senna charts roads that exist only between pulses of the rift. Her maps are written in vanished distances, safe crossings, and the silhouettes of places yet to arrive.

abilities.name: Breach Atlas
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Signal or Guile on tests in movement or anomaly sectors.

abilities.name: Surveyor's Cut
abilities.text: Once per round, when you accept a multi-stop route Contract, set its progress to at least 1.
